name: Natalie Scott
story: Natalie Scott of Interpret Geospatial Solutions presented “Safer Communities: Improving Auckland’s Walkability” at the 2017 New Zealand Esri User Conference. The case records consultancy GIS being applied to urban walkability and transport-related spatial analysis.
